purpose.zh: 练单腿平衡和髋部控制
purpose.en: Build single-leg balance and hip control.

text.zh: 单腿站稳，另一只脚轻点三个方向
text.en: Balance on one leg and lightly tap the other foot in three directions

text.zh: 点地不转移重心，骨盆保持水平
text.en: Tap without shifting your weight and keep your pelvis level.

text.zh: 支撑膝盖微屈，对准脚尖
text.en: Keep your standing knee soft and over your toes.

commonErrors.en: Putting weight on the tapping foot.
Letting the standing knee cave in.

cautions.zh: 周围留出空间，需要时扶稳
cautions.en: Clear space around you and hold on to something if needed.
